note: Each config is kept when Inventory.has finds its name at any depth but read by its exact root path, so a nested-only copy reads as unreadable (UNKNOWN). Three user configs under $HOME are read too, unless --no-user-config, and Claude Code's ~/.claude.json is parsed: its top-level mcpServers or the projects entry of this checkout's path.

The store is looked for in AUDIT_INDEX_STORE, then three folders under $HOME, then this team artifact in the target; only a *.db store is opened, and its projects table is read for a root_path that resolves to the target.

The store of IDX-02 (no repository text); a git-revision column of the matching project row is compared with HEAD as a probe. With no such column, its indexed_at is compared with the time HEAD last moved (git's committer time and reflog).

where.unexercised: IDX-03 looks for the store only as a Tier-C probe (--run-gates) on a git target, and the recording runs no probe
